Send clause: TestAVPCatalogRoundTrip checks FlagReserved clear across catalog AVP writers (all via WriteAVPHeader, which never sets bits 0x3C00), and the .ci fixture independently asserts bits 2-5 clear on every AVP of a live UDP SCCRP. Receive clause: TestAVPIteratorReservedBits verifies AVPIterator.Next flags FlagReserved|FlagUnrecognized; TestRFC2661ReservedAVPBitTreatedAsUnrecognized (ICRQ: M=0 ignored, M=1 one CDN and no session) and TestUnrecognizedMandatoryAVPInHelloClearsTunnel (HELLO: M=1 StopCCN and tunnel closed, M=0 ignored) prove full M-bit handling.
